# tw-epic-spinners v2 beta

> 20 composable CSS loading spinners. Tailwind CSS v3 and v4. No runtime JavaScript.

## Install and register

After publication: npm install -D tw-epic-spinners@2.0.0-beta.1
In this repository demo/ links the local package. Build it with yarn npm:build.
Tailwind v4: @import "tailwindcss"; @plugin "tw-epic-spinners";
Tailwind v3: import spinners from 'tw-epic-spinners'; add it to plugins.

## Markup

The root spinner-<name> selects the design. All repeated direct children use
the shared spinner-item class, regardless of spinner type.

Container class: spinner-<name>. Every repeated direct child: spinner-item.
Example:
<div class="spinner-flower spinner-size-16 text-violet-500">
  <div class="spinner-item"></div>
  <div class="spinner-item text-pink-500"></div>
  <div class="spinner-item"></div>
</div>

Add/remove items and CSS automatically adjusts positions, size and animation phase.
Only matching items belong directly inside the container: sibling counting includes
all sibling elements. No manual counts/indices, runtime helper, or creator() export.
Named parts are styling hooks; the animation owns transforms. Use CSS variables or
custom keyframes to customize motion. Baselines are editable starting points.

## Utilities

spinner-size-* sets the overall square footprint for ALL spinners. Supports theme,
decimal, arbitrary, and responsive values. In v4, spinner-size-* mirrors native
size-* (numbers times --spacing, CSS theme tokens, fractions, keywords, arbitrary
values and (--variable) shorthand). spinner-duration-* mirrors duration-*:
non-negative whole milliseconds, --transition-duration-* theme tokens, [time],
(--variable), and initial. Both utilities respect @theme inline. No predefined
numeric scales. In v3, both use the configured spacing/transitionDuration scales.
text-* controls currentColor on the container or individual items. Class order is
irrelevant. Public variables: --spinner-size and --spinner-duration.
Component-specific geometry and easing stay in each spinner; no global stagger.
Periodic selectors repeat baseline roles without a maximum child index.
Grid spinners use ceil(sqrt(count)) columns; incomplete last rows fill from the left.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; expose an accessible loading label outside the
aria-hidden decorative spinner (paused original frames can be invisible).

## Browser requirements

Checked 2026-10-31: sibling-index()/sibling-count() reached Baseline Newly
available in August 2026, not Widely available. Chrome/Edge 138+, Safari 26.2+,
Firefox 154+. Trigonometry and sqrt are Widely available; round/mod (grid layouts)
reached Newly available in May 2024, reaching 30 months in November 2026.
Tailwind v3 support does not mean old browser support. --spacing()/--theme()
are Tailwind build-time functions, not runtime browser requirements.
Older-browser alternatives: framework/server CSS metadata, an optional DOM
helper, or a bounded selector fallback. Grid metadata must also replace round/mod.
These adapters are researched options, not shipped. No polyfill. V1 remains usable.

## Versions

V2 is 2.0.0-beta.1, a breaking redesign with editable named parts and no creator().
V1.3.0 retains its old markup and helper; npm install -D tw-epic-spinners@1.
See the v1 Git branch when maintaining old projects. Effects retain their original
motifs but are redesigned rather than pixel-identical copies of v1.

## Demo lab

The home page shows the gallery then an embedded Monaco sandbox at /#lab.
Select a baseline and edit HTML/CSS in separate tabs with live preview. Prettier
formats the active file; Copy code includes both. Reset replaces both files.
Size and duration utilities compile on demand using Tailwind v4 and this plugin
in a worker. Other Tailwind classes use the demo CSS; custom CSS works immediately.
The sandboxed preview disables scripts and supports light/dark backgrounds.
There are no standalone /lab or /playground routes.
